name: Red Lotus Flower
source:
One night you're living your normal routine, wondering what to do the coming weekend.
The next you're experiencing the outbreak of a full blown global pandemic, wondering what the fuck just happened.

And now you suddenly promised this strange girl to get her safely back to her family.
Will you lose yourself in a maelstrom of violence and despair or will you even find happiness?​

[From F95Zone]
